entries.release_truth: The item set describes a different album, "Draft: Ember Wharf", from the candidate release "Draft: Northern Lines"; the two share only their leading word. The correct verdict for the pairing is medium (review), never strong (auto-apply), and the record's applied_fields show beets overwriting the item's own album tag with the candidate's title.
